leads.location: Sitka, with operations in Juneau and Ketchikan
leads.why_picked: Highest fit total across all four scout segments. The operational pain is published in their own live job posting, the contact is verifiable on their own domain, and they publicly recommitted to day tours after closing their overnight line for overhead reasons.
leads.contact_source: https://allenmarinetours.com/contact-us/ (general Sitka office inbox, verified live three times, no personal address is published anywhere)
leads.outcome: Reduce the cost and recovery time of a changed sailing day, and make that cost visible for the first time.
leads.recommended_build: Sailing Day Control, v1 downscoped to the Operating Day Ledger. One port, read-only shared state, structured change capture, templated fan out, acknowledgement tracking, immutable event log. ZERO AI in v1.
leads.roi_summary: Two to three week instrumentation slice priced as decision data. Conservative recovers 105 percent of cost at month 12 (break even), most likely 196 percent at month 6, aggressive 345 percent at month 4. Payback four to twelve months. Both cash lines are spend avoided with us, conditional on a winter build being on their table.
leads.draft_subject: Allen Marine field study, free, and the build we recommend has no AI in it
leads.sent_note: Sent by Talon by hand after review, with light edits to voice and the closing ask. The routine drafted only.

leads.segment: other labor-scarce or paperwork-heavy Alaska SMBs
leads.why_picked: Employee-owned environmental research and consulting firm. Won a four-way tie at fit_total 23 on the substance of the verified contact path.
leads.contact_source: verified on two independent ABR pages
leads.recommended_build: A cited search and assembly tool over an audited corpus of ABR's own approved proposal text.
leads.roi_summary: Conservative $36,600 cost / $8,861 return / 24 percent recovered / no payback in five years. Break-even 31.1 submissions a year.
leads.outcome: Study shipped, build NOT recommended at observable volume.

leads.segment: Alaska Native corporations and tribal enterprises
leads.location: Anchorage and the Yukon-Kuskokwim Delta, Alaska
leads.why_picked: Won a three-way tie at fit_total 24 on tie-break (c), a segment we already have proof in. Values pre-screen ran before the room was spent and came back clean on detention contracting and False Claims Act history.
leads.contact_role: Oversees Calista's daily communications activities and directs Shareholder Services. Calista publishes no title for him and the study gives him none.
leads.contact_source: read verbatim on a fetched Calista press release page, dated 2012-11-07, person confirmed present on the current executive page. Confidence medium, not upgraded.
leads.recommended_build: Shareholder Reachability and Enrollment Work Queue. Roughly 85 percent deterministic, no model at all in phase one, one gated model step in phase two pre-committed not to ship if a test set does not exist.
leads.roi_summary: Conservative 32 percent of five-year cost recovered, never pays back, loses money every year once the invitation programme is costed. Most likely 118 percent, payback month 44, which the study calls slow. Aggressive 263 percent, month 14, printed as a ceiling we would not plan on. No row marked verified.
leads.outcome: Study shipped after eleven study-critic rounds. Two reflex builds for this segment killed on evidence, the federal proposal engine (RICE 1.67) and a Shareholder voice agent (RICE 14.06). Roster count corrected in code from 213/217 to 127. Ask is a two-week look at six to eight thousand with a written fail line, then a $40,500 pilot priced as decision data.

leads.why_picked: Tied at 24 with three others across all four segments and alone at reachability 5, a general business email published on its own contact page. First healthcare lead in the ledger, a segment the market notes call the highest-ROI domain in the state.
leads.outcome: Field Study delivered. Recommends a two-week deterministic build with NO AI in it, and advises against buying an ambient scribe from anyone because athenahealth has committed to bundling one into the fee they already pay.
leads.recommended_build: Rules-first pre-call access kit plus a structured callback queue, two weeks fixed at $13,500, with a conditional paper-to-athenahealth intake pipeline gated on three binary unknowns
leads.roi_summary: Conservative 1.7x over five years, 50 percent covered by cash alone, payback month 48 on recurring benefit alone. Zero verified rows, no volume data is published anywhere.
